Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: crisp high-resolution 2D game consecutive sprite sheet.
Reference is IDENTITY and OUTFIT ONLY, not poses to copy. Exactly the same mature bearded Nobunaga: black high ponytail/red tie, bright red lamellar armor, black trousers, red-and-gold floral cloak, red shin armor, black/gold shoes; stocky compact six-head proportions, same head/hand/leg sizes. Reference defines identity only. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands total; BOTH hands physically hold the same katana handle. Do NOT retain a third resting hand at the waist.
Draw SIX genuinely different consecutive full-body drawings in exactly TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS. Square canvas. Each wide cell has full blade/cape/feet inside it, minimum 30 pixels gap between adjacent opaque shapes; minimum 50 pixels clear outer margins. Keep blade tips below the top margin. Exactly two figures per row, separated rows with no touching components. Large native anatomical drawings, upright skull-to-soles approximately 300 pixels at actual output, NEVER shrink body to fit a long sword; instead sword can sweep in the wide cell. Consistent anatomical scale across all six frames, same camera facing right. TWO hands grip the single sword handle in EVERY frame, right hand near guard and left hand near pommel.
Sharp closed ink outlines, opaque cel colors, detailed armor and face, no blur/soft edges, no motion smears/trails/ghosts, no text/grid/borders, no shadows, no background, true alpha transparency.
Motion is a game adaptation of armored Japanese two-handed sword cuts. Hips and foot pressure lead shoulders; bent elbows carry blade through an ARC. A CUT passes in front then finishes on the OPPOSITE side. NEVER substitute both straight arms thrusting sword point horizontally forward. End weapon direction must match the stated pose. Do not draw all frames holding sword forward.

Action rising, FIRST half (preparation into cutting). Global sequence has twelve drawings, frame 6 is contact. Draw ONLY these six global frames in row-major order:
0: Low right-rear guard, two hands near right hip, blade points down and backward, knees deeply flexed.
1: Draw blade farther back beside right rear calf, load rear foot.
2: Hips lower and coil, both hands still low at right side.
3: Maximum low coil: tip down-left behind rear leg, bent elbows beside waist.
4: Rear foot drives upward, pelvis rotates before shoulders, hands begin rising diagonal path.
5: Blade sweeps upward across abdomen/chest, hands near torso, edge leads through target.
